components.name: Primary action
components.description: A prominent native link to professional work.
components.html: Professional Experience
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; background: var(--ink, #2e2639); color: var(--bg, #f8f7fb); padding: 13px 21px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; min-height: 48px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #654583); color: var(--bg, #f8f7fb); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Text link
components.description: A secondary destination with a stroked directional arrow.
components.html: Research
components.css: .ds-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .25em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; padding: 10px 0; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);color: var(--ink, #2e2639); } .ds-text:hover { color: var(--accent, #654583); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Theme control
components.description: Theme-switch appearance; application JavaScript owns preference changes and pressed state.
components.css: .ds-theme { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7cedf); background: transparent; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 24px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);color: var(--ink, #2e2639); } .ds-theme:hover { background: var(--surface, #eee9f5); border-color: var(--muted, #665b73); } .ds-theme:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .6; } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Bulk disclosure control
components.description: The expand-all control; application JavaScript changes all details and its label.
components.css: .ds-expand { display: block; background: var(--surface, #eee9f5); border: 0; border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);color: var(--ink, #2e2639); } .ds-expand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Desktop native navigation with the current destination underlined.
components.html: HomeWorkResearchPublicationsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 28px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);color: var(--ink, #2e2639); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 10px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent, #654583); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; height: 2px; background: var(--accent, #654583); position: absolute; bottom: 3px; left: 0; right: 0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.css: .ds-details { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d7cedf); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d7cedf); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);color: var(--ink, #2e2639); } .ds-details summary { list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 23px 4px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-title { font: 500 24px/1.3 var(--font-display, Afacad, "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif); } .ds-details summary::after { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); margin: 0 5px 4px auto; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 220ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)); } .ds-details[open] > summary::after { transform: rotate(225deg); margin-bottom: -3px; } .ds-details summary:hover { color: var(--accent, #654583); } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #654583); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-content { padding: 0 4px 24px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.75; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-details summary::after { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The site pairs a cursor-reactive field drawing with the directness of a personal introduction. Pale lilac grounds, plum lettering, open sections, and humanist display type give technical work a thoughtful, approachable setting. Reading pages carry the same materials into long-form content.

The presentation is spacious at the page level and compact within lists. Headings establish hierarchy; thin rules separate related entries; native disclosures let readers choose their depth. This records the finished plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript implementation, with no approved visual comp. The source of truth is `assets/css/style.css`, with interaction behavior in `assets/js/theme.js` and `assets/js/navigation.js`.
keyCharacteristics: Plum and pale lilac, with chartreuse reserved for selection and optical accents.
Afacad display lettering paired with Public Sans reading text.
Continuous sections, open rows, and fine dividing lines.
A field drawing with local spring-based thread interaction, gently moving on its own and hidden on mobile.
Light by default, with a persistent dark option and native disclosures.
Semantic career milestones and visible tool-to-application lanes; static research diagrams explain relationships using the same plum linework.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Apply colors through semantic CSS variables so text, boundaries, surfaces, and the drawing change together when the visitor switches themes.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Afacad for identity and reading hierarchy, and Public Sans for body text, navigation, and supporting information.

rules.name: The Open Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate reading groups with spacing, tonal bands, or fine rules; preserve the flat surfaces used by the finished site.

dos: **Do** use semantic palette variables and verify both themes when adding a surface.
**Do** use the self-hosted Afacad and Public Sans roles for a consistent hierarchy.
**Do** preserve open reading rows, readable line lengths, and the mobile single-column flow.
**Do** retain native links, disclosures, visible focus, and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: **Don't** turn the personal homepage into metric tiles or a dashboard.
**Don't** make decorative artwork carry factual claims or reading instructions.
**Don't** replace working disclosure and navigation semantics with decorative interactions.
**Don't** force motion or a dark default over the visitor's accessible reading experience.
